evidence.requirements: The whole app/ directory holds two files: app/data/cartridges.js (the 25 records as a JSONL string on window.CARTRIDGE_JSONL, lines 6-30) and an empty app/openspec/specs/.gitkeep. The brief requires `index.html` in the project root, and there isn't one. There is also no JavaScript or CSS that would parse or render the data. Not met: start page (Cartridges heading, linked names, family, L3, Search, Family select, '<n> cartridges'); detail view (heading, metadata, capacity link, grouped Symbol/Value/Unit tables, Print button, 'All cartridges' link, bookmarkable address); SVG drawing (scale, outside view and section, centre line, dimension lines for L3/L6/R1/R/P1/P2/H1/H2/G1/L1/L2/E1/α, title block, responsive sizing); geometry rules 1-9; print layout; light and dark themes; angle, tolerance and symbol formatting. The only thing met is the data copied verbatim.
evidence.correctness: Nothing is computed or drawn, so no geometry, proportions, dimension values, angle or tolerance formatting, or print fit can be checked. The screenshots/ directory does not exist, which per the instructions means the automated check could not reach any page. The data in cartridges.js matches brief.md lines 64-88 one for one.
evidence.security: No markup or script renders anything, so there is no innerHTML, eval or network request. cartridges.js defines a template-literal string and contains no backticks or ${ in the data. This 'pass' only holds because there is no code at all, so there is nothing to credit.
evidence.code_quality: Apart from the data constant there is no application code: no structure, no naming, no error handling to assess. The task is essentially unaddressed.
evidence.tests: No tests, no test runner configuration, no package.json. Nothing covers the brief's requirements or the drawing rules.
evidence.ux_design: No screenshots exist (no list.jpg, detail-*.jpg or print-308_win.jpg) and there is no index.html. Users get no interface at all.
evidence.accessibility: No HTML, so there is no drawing text alternative, no table headers, labels, keyboard handling or focus styles.
evidence.simplicity: Having no dependencies is not simplicity here: the amount of code (zero lines of app logic) does not fit the problem, because the product is missing.
evidence.maintainability: No README, docs, ADRs, specs (openspec/specs holds only .gitkeep), no CI, no package.json or pinned Node version, no versioning approach. A new developer would have to build everything from scratch.
evidence.visual_design: No screenshots and no CSS. There is no visual design to judge.
evidence.layout: No pages exist, so there is no layout. The screenshots directory is absent.
evidence.usability: Users cannot list, search, filter, open, view or print a cartridge. None of the brief's tasks can be done.
evidence.reception: A reloader, gunsmith or engineer opening the delivery would find no app, only a data file. They would not use it or recommend it.

unmet_requirements: index.html in the project root that works from file:// and from a static server (missing entirely)
Start page: 'Cartridges' heading, every cartridge with a name link, family and L3
Search field filtering by name and alternative names
Family select (All, rimless, rimmed, belted, pistol, rimfire)
Detail view heading and metadata (alternative names, family, category, primer, tab, country, dates, pressure method, capacity with source link)
Cartridge and chamber value tables grouped by section with Symbol/Value/Unit columns, tolerances inline, angles formatted, symbol renames
Bookmarkable per-cartridge address that survives reload
Inline SVG drawing at 1 unit = 1 mm, head left, accessible name '<name> drawing'
Outside-view upper half, hatched section lower half, dash-dot centre line
Dimension lines with arrowheads, extension lines and labelled values for L3, L6, R1, R, P1 and, where published, P2, H1, H2, G1, L1, L2, E1, α, without overlaps
Title block (name, tab, revision date, 'Dimensions in mm', scale)
Geometry rules 1-9 (rim type, chamfer/rimfire rim, extractor groove/belt, body, shoulder with radii, neck, bullet seating/shape/heel, section walls/head/primer pocket, missing-value notes)
Print: one A4 portrait page, black on white, header, full-width drawing, tables, no navigation, footer with source
Light and dark themes following the system setting; dense technical typography with tabular numbers
strengths: The 25 records are copied verbatim into app/data/cartridges.js with source attribution (lines 1-5), with no data added or changed.
Loading the data as a JS global instead of fetching it would let the app work over file://, if an app existed.
No external requests, eval or dependencies, though only because there is no code.
issues: No application was delivered: there is no index.html, no JavaScript logic and no CSS, so neither the start page nor the detail view exists (app/ holds only data/cartridges.js and openspec/specs/.gitkeep).
None of the drawing requirements or geometry rules 1-9 is implemented, and the screenshots directory is missing because no page could be reached.
No tests, README, docs, specs, package.json or CI, so the work cannot be verified, run or maintained.
review.verdict: The delivery is only the brief's cartridge data wrapped in a JavaScript string. There is no index.html, no rendering code, no drawing, no tests and no documentation. It cannot be published: no part of the product brief is met beyond carrying over the data.
